name: cjk-experiment-v2
authorization_scope: User authorized removing unnecessary article-ID prerequisite and maintaining research evidence. No fitting authorized in this amendment.
evidence_context: Motivated by already-inspected FLORES pilot; separate candidate texts acquired and audited, but no candidate token counts, fitted coefficients or test errors computed.
hypothesis: Split CJK coefficients improve independent test error beyond a newly fitted pooled coefficient
frozen_features: All non-CJK weights and character classifications unchanged, including other and punctuation
inference: Same per-character binary64 summation order then ceiling as original

data_policy.fit: official train of three primary varieties only
data_policy.test: official test, no error inspection until coefficients and code frozen
data_policy.flores: No fitting, calibration, model selection or devtest access
data_policy.text_extraction: Exact # text value from CoNLL-U; exclude missing/empty and log; never reconstruct with inserted spaces
data_policy.sampling: All eligible rows; equal language weight, no score-dependent filtering
data_policy.grouping: Always group exact/near duplicates and known translation/conversion families. Use reliable source-document groups when available; record unknown article dependence without blocking on missing IDs.
data_policy.cross_split_action: Keep only members from most restrictive split; exclude earlier-split members
data_policy.dedup_matching: NFC plus collapsed whitespace, leaving original measurement input unchanged
data_policy.near_duplicate_rule: Character 5-gram set Jaccard >= 0.9 for normalized texts >=20 code points; otherwise exact only
data_policy.upstream_overlap_screen: Exclude matches to cached FLORES dev and 38 published fixtures; no devtest access

feasibility_floors.meaning: Text-count and feature-coverage feasibility only; original-document IDs are optional. This does not establish independent examples or statistical power.

fit.objective: Equal-language mean squared relative residual (O+Xw-T)/T on development train
fit.optimization: Enumerate active subsets; binary64 weighted least squares; minimum feasible objective, then min L2 norm and lexicographic tie-break

evaluation.primary_metric: Equal-language mean absolute percentage error per tokenizer, then equal mean over five tokenizers
evaluation.support_rule: Descriptive exploratory finding only: primary macro error lower for split than pooled on this fixed cleaned test set. Report full effect and all cell regressions; no statistical-significance claim.
evaluation.practical_relevance_flag: At least 10% relative reduction in primary macro metric; undefined if pooled error zero
evaluation.tradeoff_flag: Any primary cell undercount>20% or overcount>20% rate worsens by more than 5 percentage points

bootstrap.reason: Original article dependence unknown. Do not present duplicate groups or individual sentences as independent article samples. A later uncertainty analysis needs a separately specified defensible sampling model.

preflight_required: Use pinned source revisions and document source-text use basis; no raw text redistribution
Freeze exclusions and known duplicate/translation/source components; unknown source-document identities are a limitation, not a blocker
Freeze cleaned split manifest and validate row-count and feature-coverage floors
Review bounded exploratory design; obtain explicit authorization before coefficient fitting
Pin solver/runtime and validate feature parity on synthetic cases before fitting
next_action: Complete the narrow source-text use check, then freeze cleaned sentence-level splits under v2; do not attempt exhaustive article recovery or fit weights yet.

supersedes.reason: User requested focused study; original-document recovery is disproportionate for a bounded exploratory sentence-level comparison.
